notes: ProofHouseToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Proof House (ARTIFACTS) with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no transfer fees, post-deployment minting, or administrative powers. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
